approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Person Notes should be handled as structured staff context on a person record; note type, visibility, sensitivity, and lifecycle matter as much as the note text itself.

notes: Read-only SQL verified Note and NoteType tables plus Auth surfaces used to manage note type, visibility, sensitivity, and lifecycle.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Use Note Types to govern where notes appear, how they are categorized, and which staff roles can create or view sensitive notes; do not treat all person notes as one undifferentiated field.

notes: Read-only SQL verified Note and NoteType surfaces with permission-capable Auth rows, supporting note-type governance and visibility review.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: When a v19 person merge changes the surviving last name, Rock can add the former value to Previous Last Names for visible continuity on the person profile. Verify local field visibility and data-handling policy before relying on it.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: The Person Profile is a dense operational surface; agents should identify which tab, block, badge, note, attribute, or action is involved before troubleshooting or changing access.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Data Integrity work should be repeatable: identify the record population, define the correction rule, test with known examples, and document the owner before making bulk changes.
Before launching preregistration broadly, teams should test the full path from public form through family record creation, check-in eligibility, and staff follow-up.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Person Profile security should be reviewed at the page, block, entity, action, and data-field level because profile visibility does not imply permission to edit every person-related record.

notes: Read-only SQL verified the connected instance has person, page, block, Auth, note, and attribute surfaces needed for profile-security review.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Rock v19 can assign record sources on external person-entry blocks and show that source in duplicate detail, helping data-integrity staff trace where repeated records originated.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Data integrity work should start from the exact entity and field being corrected, then identify the owner, source of truth, duplicate risk, and reporting impact before changing records.

notes: Read-only SQL verified entity/field, attribute value, DataView, Report, and person-alias surfaces used to trace source of truth and reporting impact before data corrections.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Person Profile adds people/security guidance: profile work should identify the exact tab, block, action, and data surface before troubleshooting visibility or edit access.

notes: Read-only SQL verified person/profile-adjacent page/block/Auth/note/attribute surfaces needed to identify exact tabs, blocks, actions, and data surfaces.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: People and reporting guides should distinguish cleanup, merge, verification, and governance tasks because each has different audit and permission requirements.

notes: Read-only SQL verified people, reporting, and Auth surfaces needed to separate cleanup, merge, verification, governance, audit, and permission review.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Agents should inspect connection types, opportunities, statuses, activities, workflows, and staff ownership together because a connection request is both a person record and a process state.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Personalization should be reviewed as conditional content delivery, not as a security substitute; hidden or targeted content still needs proper page, block, and entity authorization.

notes: Read-only SQL verified actor-data, page, block, Auth, and attribute surfaces needed to distinguish personalization from authorization.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: When troubleshooting connections, identify whether the problem is person context, request status, opportunity configuration, staff assignment, or automation rather than treating it as one generic workflow issue.

notes: Read-only SQL verified person, request, status, opportunity, assignment, and workflow surfaces needed to separate connection troubleshooting causes.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Connections Overview adds workflow guidance for connection ministries: separate person context, request status, opportunity setup, assignment, and automation when diagnosing issues.

notes: Read-only SQL verified connection person/process surfaces: type, opportunity, status, request, assignment, and workflow tables/columns.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Personalization adds CMS/security guidance: targeted content should be tested with real actor state and must not be treated as a replacement for authorization.

notes: Read-only SQL verified personalization-capable Content Channel View attributes, page/block surfaces, and Auth surfaces supporting the distinction between targeted content and authorization.

notes: Read-only SQL verified connection request state, opportunity, type, status, assignment, and workflow surfaces that support engagement-process auditing.
